learning.practiceHint: Finish the checkpoint before moving on.
learning.curriculumDescription: Do not read APIs in alphabetical order. Every phase ends with something you can build from a blank file before you move on.

foundation.label: Phase 01
foundation.title: Motion foundations
foundation.description: Learn GSAP grammar and build the first dependable interactions.

interaction.label: Phase 02
interaction.title: Flow & interaction
interaction.description: Connect motion to scroll, SVG, text and component lifecycles.

advanced.label: Phase 03
advanced.title: Design to ship
advanced.description: Turn techniques into motion systems that survive real products.

hero.description: Learn GSAP by building, testing and checking your work. Every lesson is a motion skill you can use, not an API page to skim.
